ADDENDUM 7 §7.5's "exactly one statement" was a claim about the **certificate**, and it stands
as such. The lane's residue as a whole is now **two** items, of quite different kinds:

1. the subordinate Stacks `0B8B` input, unchanged, out of scope per I-0492 clause 2;
2. `divFamZarAff.map` along an **arbitrary morphism of test objects**, plus the functor
   packaging `divFunctorAff` on top of it. This is what `DivRepGlobalData.pull_comp` consumes,
   and it is *not* a restatement of (1): it is the widened analogue of
   `Picard/DivisorFamilyZarMap.lean`, whose input is the widened Zariski **gluing** keystone

**Diff a replacement type's API by FACE, not only by name**, and measure the absence *outside*
the new type's own cone. The cheap check is one grep: the name of the new carrier, outside the
files that define it. Zero hits means the replacement is an island however complete its own
layer looks, and a green sorry-free build cannot see it — the missing thing is an absence.

ADDENDUM 6 item 5 listed two owed obligations. One of them was never an obligation of the
*widened* layer at all, and the reason is worth stating because it generalises past this lane.

### 7.1 The discharge, and why it was available

`ThetaGeneratorSeed.affAdaptation_fibre_regular` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffFibre.lean`,
`5e77976f4`) supplies `hfib` for **every** `AffCoverData` and **every** `AffAdaptation` over it:

```
affAdaptation_fibre_regular (hD : D.IsGenerator) (Dc : AffCoverData C R)
  (A : AffAdaptation Dc (D.localEquations hD)) (j) (p) :
  A.eqn j ⊗ 1 ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Γ(Dc.pieces j) ⊗_R κ(p))
```

The chart-typed lane discharges its own `hfib` through
`DivisorAdaptation.eqn_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_seed`, and the natural reading is that
this is chart machinery. **It is not.** Trace what it consumes: it bottoms out at
`ThetaGeneratorSeed.germ_self_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`, whose *statement* mentions the
local-equation system `d`, the fibre curve over `κ(p)`, and nothing else — no cover, no pieces,
no chart, no partition of unity. It says: *the pulled system equation is regular at its own
point*. That is a property of the seed and the fibre.

```
(hD : D.IsGenerator) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hsub : supp d ⊆ W)
  (hWle : W ≤ d.cover.opens z₀) (hrank : rank of the SWALLOWING colength = n)
  : ∃ Dc A, A.IsCertified n
```

`hfib` is gone; `hproj` is gone as a hypothesis and **derived** inside, since the discharged
fibrewise datum feeds `projective_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField`. The file exists rather
than a prose note precisely because ADDENDUM 6's session learned that a producer and a consumer
can each be correct and still not compose — `AffAdaptation` needs *subordination*, and bare
containment does not give it. Composition is checked by the elaborator here.

### 7.5 What is left

> **SCOPE CORRECTED by ADDENDUM 8 (same day, session 0010):** "exactly one statement" is a claim
> about the **certificate**, and as such it stands. It is not true of the lane, which also owed
> the widened carrier's explicit-map face and its vehicle/functor layer — measured absent, now
> landed (§8.2) except for `divFamZarAff.map` along an arbitrary test morphism. Read §8.3 for
> the two-item residue.

**Exactly one statement:** the subordinate Stacks `0B8B` input — an affine open `W` containing
`supp D` and contained in one member of `d.cover`. I-0492 clause 2 directs the lane to USE it,
not re-derive it; mathlib has no form of `0B8B` and this tree constructs no curve but `P¹`. The
degree datum `hrank` is not a *missing* input in the same sense: it is the honest content of
"the divisor has degree `n`", and it is now stated at the one affine open where the divisor is.

  module IS rooted. Only elaboration disagrees. So when auditing a port, ''sorry-free
  and rooted'' is not evidence of green -- run ''lake env lean <file>'' or read LSP
  diagnostics on the file itself.

  a call site, #check BOTH the old and the new callee and diff their BINDER EXPLICITNESS,
  not just their argument lists. Widened/replacement APIs in this tree routinely differ
  from their originals by exactly one binder''s explicitness -- because the new declaration''s
  section variables differ, so what was inferable becomes explicit. The resulting

  assumes''.

  quantifier and confirm the theorem''s hypotheses do not escape it.

  zero consumers, AffCoverData has zero producers beyond the migration map, SwallowedBy
  has zero witnesses, and the 33 partition0/partition1 hits the decision said had
  to go are all still there. A widening that no consumer reaches leaves the old carrier
  as the live one.'

  \ * an INSTANCE-PARAMETERIZED face, mapAlg, taking [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower\
  \ k R R'];\n * an EXPLICIT-MAP face, mapAlgHom, taking a bare (phi : A ->a[k] A').\n\
  They are trivially interderivable -- mapAlgHom is mapAlg at RingHom.toAlgebra of\
  \ the map, and the bridge back (mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg) is one Algebra.algebra_ext.\

  \ its compatibility condition by section-restriction maps (Over.resAlgHom), which\
  \ are bare AlgHoms carrying no tower instance. So divFamZar and divFunctor in AJCR\

body: 'A PORTED FILE CAN BE PRESENT, REACHABLE, AND RED -- a third variety alongside
  I-0624''s advertised-but-absent and present-but-unreachable, and neither a sorry
  census nor a job count sees it. AJCR run 0070 s0010 (ajcr-cert-r2), measured.


  THE INSTANCE. Picard/DivisorFamilyAffGlueZar.lean, a port of the Zariski gluing
  keystone to the widened R2 carrier: ZERO sorries, in the root import cone, no name
  collisions, and it FAILED to elaborate. ''lake build'' stopped with ''Invalid field
  notation: type of l is not known; cannot resolve field down'', pointing at a ULift
  binder twenty lines from the real cause.


  THE CAUSE, one argument. DivFamZarAff.eq_of_away_eq takes n : Nat as an EXPLICIT
  LEADING argument. Its chart-typed counterpart DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq has n implicit
  at that position (it is fixed by the section variables). A port that copies the
  chart-typed call site therefore passes the away-cover FAMILY where n is expected;
  Lean then tries to unify a function type with Nat, gives up on the family''s binder,
  and reports the downstream ''l.down'' instead. Adding the single explicit n fixed
  it and the file went green in one pass.


  WHY THIS IS ITS OWN FAILURE MODE. The three cheap health checks all pass on such
  a file: grep sorry = 0, the declaration EXISTS with the right statement, and the
  module IS rooted. Only elaboration disagrees. So when auditing a port, ''sorry-free
  and rooted'' is not evidence of green -- run ''lake env lean <file>'' or read LSP
  diagnostics on the file itself.


  THE PORTING RULE THIS GENERALISES TO, and it is the cheap prophylactic: before porting
  a call site, #check BOTH the old and the new callee and diff their BINDER EXPLICITNESS,
  not just their argument lists. Widened/replacement APIs in this tree routinely differ
  from their originals by exactly one binder''s explicitness -- because the new declaration''s
  section variables differ, so what was inferable becomes explicit. The resulting
  error never names the argument that is missing.'

body: '[persistent] WHEN A LANE IS RE-BUILT ON A WIDENED CARRIER, PORT ITS PROOFS,

  from the R2 widening (run 0070, DivisorFamilyAff*.lean).


  The widening itself was done well: AffCoverData carries only m / pieces / isAffineOpen
  / joint cover, takes no pi argument, and the chart typing was correctly split out
  into an optional ChartTyping that no certificate clause mentions. flat_sections_of_flat_hom
  is a real proof of a true statement. Zero sorries.


  What went wrong is subtler and is the reusable lesson. The old lane had TWO certificate
  assemblers: a heavy kernel-spanning one (DivSchemeCertUniv.lean:71) and a light
  collapse one (DivSchemeCertZarSep.lean:277, isCertified_of_separated) that PROVES
  (c2)/(c3)/(c4) from nothing but ''off-diagonal overlap colengths vanish''. Only
  the heavy shape was carried across; the light one was left behind and its four collapse
  lemmas re-appear as HYPOTHESES in DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean:79-84. The justification
  given was a standing refutation (I-0340: the difference arrow''s diagonal vanishes
  identically, so (c4) is never free FOR AN ARBITRARY ADAPTATION). But the new assembler
  runs under SwallowedBy, where off-diagonal overlaps are all subsingleton and the
  diagonal factors are either the swallowing piece''s own colength or subsingleton
  — i.e. precisely the situation the collapse lemma covers. A refutation of ''free
  in general'' is not a refutation of ''free under the extra hypothesis this theorem
  assumes''.


  TWO CHECKS TO RUN BEFORE ACCEPTING A HYPOTHESIS IN A PORTED THEOREM. (1) grep the
  pre-widening lane for a lemma that CONCLUDES that hypothesis, and check whether
  its own hypotheses are available in the new setting — DivSchemeCertZarSep.lean imports
  no chart file, so all of it transports. (2) If a docstring cites a refutation to
  explain why something is assumed rather than proved, restate the refutation''s exact
  quantifier and confirm the theorem''s hypotheses do not escape it.


  THIRD, SEPARATE LESSON: ''landed alongside'' is not ''executed''. DivFamZarAff has
  zero consumers, AffCoverData has zero producers beyond the migration map, SwallowedBy
  has zero witnesses, and the 33 partition0/partition1 hits the decision said had
  to go are all still there. A widening that no consumer reaches leaves the old carrier
  as the live one.'

`ThetaGeneratorSeed.affAdaptation_fibre_regular` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffFibre.lean`,

```
affAdaptation_fibre_regular (hD : D.IsGenerator) (Dc : AffCoverData C R)
  (A : AffAdaptation Dc (D.localEquations hD)) (j) (p) :
  A.eqn j ⊗ 1 ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Γ(Dc.pieces j) ⊗_R κ(p))
```

The chart-typed lane discharges its own `hfib` through
`DivisorAdaptation.eqn_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_seed`, and the natural reading is that
this is chart machinery. **It is not.** Trace what it consumes: it bottoms out at
`ThetaGeneratorSeed.germ_self_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`, whose *statement* mentions the
local-equation system `d`, the fibre curve over `κ(p)`, and nothing else — no cover, no pieces,
no chart, no partition of unity. It says: *the pulled system equation is regular at its own
point*. That is a property of the seed and the fibre.

```
(hD : D.IsGenerator) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hsub : supp d ⊆ W)
  (hWle : W ≤ d.cover.opens z₀) (hrank : rank of the SWALLOWING colength = n)
  : ∃ Dc A, A.IsCertified n
```

`hfib` is gone; `hproj` is gone as a hypothesis and **derived** inside, since the discharged
fibrewise datum feeds `projective_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField`. The file exists rather

can each be correct and still not compose — `AffAdaptation` needs *subordination*, and bare
containment does not give it. Composition is checked by the elaborator here.
